India and New Zealand Sign Free Trade Agreement

India and New Zealand have signed a free trade agreement aimed at enhancing economic relations between the two countries. The deal, which was announced by New Zealand Prime Minister Christopher Luxon, will make over 50% of New Zealand's exports to India tariff-free from the start. The agreement is expected to increase trade between the two countries to five billion dollars in five years.
